app_fee.value: The graduate application fee is $75 in the 2026-27 official notice, paid online and non-refundable.
app_fee.quote: Howard University requires the following non-refundable out-of-pocket fees and deposits for application and enrollment. | Graduate Application $75

also.quote: you will be assessed a non-refundable application processing fee when submitting their online application

fee_waiver.value: The admissions office says it does not offer application fee waivers at this time, so international applicants pay the full fee.
fee_waiver.quote: *NOTE: Unfortunately, our office does not offer application fee waivers at this time.

gre_general.value: The graduate school sets no single GRE rule: some programs may require the GRE, so each program record states its own rule.
gre_general.quote: Some Graduate School programs may require the GRE

toefl_min.value: The graduate school's TOEFL iBT minimum is 90 (233 on the CBT scale).
toefl_min.quote: minimum score of 233 CBT (computer-based test) or 90 iBT (internet-based test)

ielts_min.value: The graduate school's IELTS minimum is an overall band of 6.5, with no band below 6.0.
ielts_min.quote: minimum overall band score of 6.5, with no individual band score below 6.0

english_waiver.value: India is not on the graduate school's TOEFL/IELTS-exempt country list, but the school waives the test for applicants from a foreign university that taught in English, once the Office of Admissions approves the request.
english_waiver.quote: We will waive the English language testing requirement for applicants who attended a foreign university that offered instruction in English. | Howard University’s Office of Admissions will review and approve requests made on this basis.

also.quote: If you hold (or will earn before starting at Howard) at least a bachelor's degree from one of the following countries, then you do not have to submit a TOEFL/IELTS exam score

notes: Graduate school rules from gs.howard.edu, which the graduate school uses for GradCAS and EngineeringCAS. gradschool.howard.edu and gsas.howard.edu failed at the agent proxy (502 to CONNECT), so gs.howard.edu was used. The $75 fee is the 2026-27 figure. The fee-waiver note appears on the admissions page under the School of Social Work list; it is applied here to the graduate application because the same page says the Graduate Admission Application is not applicable to undergraduates.
